source_scope: Independent full Amex raw preprocessing, manual/sequence features, grouped row DART, downstream tree/neural variants and literal blend on CPU.

stage_mapping.memory_optimization: Correct generic memory optimization to explicit numeric flooring and runtime category mapping. Independent floating-point storage; no historical memory/downcast equivalence.
stage_mapping.time_series_aggregation: Nine manual blocks, joint categorical and month ranks, timestamp-rank windows, row-model predictions, opposite padding directions and greedy normalized features.
stage_mapping.difference_features: Ordered within-customer differences preserve missing adjacency; source mean/std/min/max/sum/last and floating floor division retained.
stage_mapping.model_training: Five grouped row DART models plus two downstream five-fold DART and two five-fold neural variants. Remove unsupported XGBoost/CatBoost; preserve effective epochs, schedule, pooling and checkpoint metric.
stage_mapping.blending: Literal ordered probability sum .30 manual tree + .35 tree with slots + .15 sequence neural + .10 combined neural; coefficients sum .90 with no normalization or rank averaging.

source_reuse: Independent reconstruction; original source grant unresolved; no original code copied into repository.
